## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes (format, lint, typecheck, tests, license check).
- [ ] New behavior has tests, and the tests use the fixture sites, not real websites.
- [ ] No credentials, cookies, API keys, 2FA secrets or personal data anywhere in the change.
- [ ] No new dependency or service that needs a paid plan or a paid API key.
- [ ] Ran `pnpm changeset` if people who install toolDrop will notice this change.
- [ ] Updated SPEC.md, PLAN.md or DECISIONS.md if this changes what they say.
